purpose: Declare a symmetric East/West/South sampling and dependence topology for the Noether Interslavic marginal-intelligibility pilot while keeping official governance votes, evidence breadth, and human outcomes separate.

authority_basis.capture_state: live_primary_page_inspected; exact response bytes not yet preserved in this package
relevant_claims: maximum intelligibility for all Slavs is the primary purpose
East, West, and South are treated on an equal basis
the governance comparator uses six one-vote subgroups
sub-million languages do not vote but must still be considered

tree_contract.interpretation: This tree declares cohorts and dependence resolution. It is not a probability distribution, voting result, intelligibility index, or language-quality ranking.

protected_sentinel_leaves.sensitivity_assignment: report separately as a middle-of-road/transitional cohort

languages.governance_note: No extra official vote is inferred. Participant outcomes remain a separate leaf rather than being silently pooled.

official_groups.official_vote_share: one_of_six_split_within_group_when forms disagree in governance comparator only

protected_small_cohort_policy.principle: Voting eligibility, sample feasibility, and evidentiary relevance are different. A small cohort may lack a powered sample without being erased or imputed.
minimum_handling: retain a named leaf or an explicit documented gap
seek native source and reviewer evidence when feasible
report every observed response separately before any pooling
treat high-confidence false-friend or severe-harm evidence as adverse even when the cohort is small
never convert nonrecruitment into zero harm or zero intelligibility
add newly identified standards or minority cohorts by append-only tree succession rather than silent pooling
protected_small_cohort_policy.powered_inference_claim: none until recruitment and power simulation are frozen

forbidden_inferences: Two East-Slavic sources or languages do not equal pan-Slavic breadth.
The official six-vote system is not a measured comprehension distribution.
Population is not the primary empirical outcome weighting.
A missing small-cohort sample is not evidence of no harm.
Cyrillic Interslavic is a script condition, not an independent language witness.
Top-level branch symmetry does not excuse unreported within-branch leaf imbalance.
A pooled grand mean cannot erase a negative minimum-cohort effect.
continuation_cursor: Freeze recruitment feasibility and simulation-based sample targets per official group and protected sentinel; snapshot the live official design-criteria page by exact bytes; then bind item-level source units and candidate arms before collecting any human response.
